description: Find something to run: your LOCAL tools on this machine (browser/shell/git/deploy/ssh/architect/…) and every API endpoint this workspace's company can call (first-party + connected third-party). A local tool's exact name → that one tool, catalog not searched. An endpoint's or Script Vault instrument's exact tool_name → that row first, ahead of every fuzzy hit (an instrument with its full description). Auto browser sign-in if needed (no key to paste).

limit.description: Your CONTEXT budget - bounds the whole response, not just the endpoint list (default 8, max 25).

query.description: What to find; blank → your full local-tool inventory.

use_case.description: What you are trying to get done, in a sentence (e.g. 'deploy the pay lambda and check its logs'). Sharpens the local-tool ranking; alone it is the query. The top local hit lists the tools usually run next here, and any hit its known pitfalls.

verbose.description: false (default): endpoint hits list param names only, local tools and Script Vault instruments a one-line summary. true: each hit's full parameter schema and description.

name: connections_search_catalog
title: Search your local tools and the Connections catalog
